g.text: self-tcb-reduction-driver — DRAIN CHEAP FIRST, then break ONE wall (gates W · R · P · S · B/C)
run the BASE LOOP as a sub-agent (non-interactive):
"convert the next stub your triage rates cheap_win==true"
base loop returned a cheap stub?
base loop handles it inline / skip
AND not already CERTIFIED-BOUNDARY AND cheap queue empty?
Gate R: authored blind to sub-loop
Gate P: FIRST action is a make-or-break spike
WITH a refutation exit + 3-L battery + costed scope?
Gate S — run the make-or-break spike
Gate B: 3 L-planes FRESH AND ledger==3 AND count down AND no smuggle?
Gate C: no-blend AND non-vacuity AND section-10.4 re-port?
REVERT to clean -> record a gap
(trigger/validity test -> PASS or CARVE-OUT, never keep-whole)
(a BROKEN wall may unlock new cheap stubs)
